messages:
sam: Heads up — we need to onboard the runtime's continuous-batching signals into the console. Planning sync for metric handoff + dashboard UX.
anya: +1. Which signals exactly? batch size distribution, wait time, queue depth?
mike: Main ones from runtime: batch.size_hist (histogram), batch.wait_ms_p99, queue.saturation_ratio, in_flight_per_shard. Also we should surface prefix cache hit-rate for KV cache.
jordan: For console UX let's keep a summary row: 'Current saturation', 'P99 wait', 'Median batch size', and a sparkline of batch.size_hist buckets. Then drilldowns by model and route tag.
sam: Important: router-level dimensions required — model_id, route_tag, customer_tier. If we don't have route_tag in the metric labels it's hard to attribute.
lee: Runtime can add route_tag label but need to watch cardinality. Suggest we only allow route_tag for enterprise routes; default label is 'public'.
anya: Agree on cardinality guardrails. Also we need an ingestion schema so infra knows bucket counts vs exemplars. Can infra confirm supported types?
infra-bot: ingestion-schema: accepts 'histogram' (buckets->counts), 'gauge', 'counter', 'summary'. Max label cardinality per metric: 50.
mike: For histograms we'll emit coarse buckets: [1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128] tokens. Name: runtime.batcher.batch_size_hist. Provide total_count and total_sum as well.
jordan: How do we want backlog/wait computed? batch.wait_ms will be measured at dequeue; provide p50/p95/p99 summaries. Name: runtime.batcher.wait_ms_summary.
sam: Need an alerting and rollout UX note: Dashboard should default to showing system-wide signals, but when we rollout new bucket schema we want opt-in customers to test first. Add a 'metric_version' label.
lee: Good call. We'll add metric_version string. Runtime will start with v1. infra: can you ingest metric_version as a tag for rollout?
infra-bot: ingestion-schema updated: allow metric_version label up to 8 chars. Events will be routed to a 'telemetry-testing' index when metric_version!=v1.
anya: For the console panel: include heatmap of shard saturation and a histogram selector to switch between token-buckets vs size-buckets. Also an annotation lane for deploy/rollout events.
mike: Implementation note: emitting histograms at high QPS is heavy. We'll sample 1/100 for raw exemplars and always emit aggregated buckets every 10s.
sam: OK teams: action items — runtime (mike): add metric names + labels, start emitting v1 to staging by EOD Fri. infra (lee): update ingestion schema and create telemetry-testing index. product/jordan: design dashboard prototype and UX gating. anya: draft alert thresholds for p99 wait and saturation.
jordan: I'll mock the panel in console and post screenshots by Wed.
lee: Will confirm schema changes and post PR for ingestion rules today.
mike: I'll send a small example payload shortly in this thread.
infra-bot: Note: new metric rules require a short description field. Please include in PR.
mike: Example payload (staging):
```
metric: runtime.batcher.batch_size_hist
labels: {model_id: "redwood-3b", route_tag: "public", metric_version: "v1"}
buckets: {"1":100,"2":420,"4":1300,"8":200,"16":30}
total_count:1950
total_sum:5600
```
sam: Perfect. Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene after Jordan posts the mock and infra confirms ingestion.
anya: cc @mike for sampling knobs once you're live :thumbsup:
